review_scope: New CPU/source/native-DLL integration only; no model/CUDA initialization or GPU execution
required_launch_budget_properties: One process-wide shared atomic state covers every linked CUDA translation unit, target and draft, and all submitting host threads
Per-worker launch allowance is bound to a durable reservation within the existing 4096 family ceiling; it is not 4096 newly granted to every worker
Every explicit raw launch, generic launch wrapper and kernel-launch API checks/reserves before submission; failed/aborted attempts remain charged
Missing budget, duplicate/reentrant configuration, thread races, overflow and any unknown route fail closed
CUDA graph capture/replay is disabled or refused on all A/B/C and applicable reference/draft controls, with the same declared graph policy
cuBLAS/CUB/other library submissions cannot be counted by enumerating only ggml raw launch sites; uncounted routes must be denied or separately instrumented
Source inventory and CPU counter tests do not establish dynamic physical-kernel coverage or native request qualification
Budget accounting includes model load/context initialization and runtime device work, or explicitly marks those paths unadmitted

source_backed_uninstrumented_routes_to_r.risk: Hidden library kernels are not represented by ggml raw launch syntax
Bad-padding and generic fallback can choose cuBLAS unless rejected before invocation
One replay submission can execute many kernel nodes
Environment policy is sampled into static state; must bind before initialization and verify actual backend policy
CUB work launch path is outside raw launch inventory; a block-scan primitive inside one owned kernel is a different case
Single-device profile must exclude uncounted collectives and library initialization
The source-level explicit-kernel inventory does not attest internal runtime device activity; physical-kernel coverage remains unknown without a proved policy

required_integration_evidence: A real newly linked numerical backend DLL includes C dispatcher and counter provider bindings; compiling a translation unit is insufficient
Metadata-only DLL loading records path/hash/exports without claiming GPU device initialization, dispatch execution or numerical qualification
Frontend binds actual loaded DLL identities, authorized device, graph policy and request/counter reservation before native work
C remains Q8_0/F32 q8 g2 two independent four-column accumulator groups with preserved per-output K/lane/reduction order
Actual quantized activation bytes, all outputs, target/draft state and complete real request consumers remain separate native obligations
